title: Glass Regular Mouth Mason Jars, 16 oz Clear Glass Jars with Silver Metal Lids for Sealing, Canning Jars for Food Storage, Overnight Oats, Dry Food, Snacks, Candies, DIY Projects (2 PACK)
description:
About this item
GREAT VALUE PACK - Package Includes 2 - 16 oz Jar Boss Regular Mouth Mason jars, 2 - Silver Metal Lids for Airtight Sealing, Canning Jars for Food Storage, Overnight Oats, Dry Food, Snacks, Candies, DIY Projects.
PREMIUM GLASS - Each Canning Mason Jar is made of High-Quality Crystal-Clear Blemish-Free Glass to Ensure the Highest Visibility Possible and Resistant to Breaking, Making them an Ideal choice for Lasting use.
MULTI PURPOSE - Jar Boss Mason Jars are Perfect for anything from Food Storage to Meal Prep to Snacks. Metal Lids fit all “70mm” Regular Mouth Mason jars including Ball & Kerr Regular Mouth Mason Jars.
GET CREATIVE - with Overnight Oats, Fruit Storage, Candies, Jam, Honey, Wedding Favor, Shower Favors, DIY Spice Jars, and even use them as Centerpieces, Home Decor and DIY Projects.
REGULAR MOUTH JARS - Thanks for Regular Mouth Design, our Canning Mason Jars are more Convenient for Canning Chunks of Fruits and Vegetables. And allow you to Wash by Hand, as you can easily reach to the Bottom of the Jars with a Wet Cloth.
AIRTIGHT & LEAKPROOF - The 1-piece Silver Metal Airtight Lids are Proven to Keep sliced Fruits, Vegetables, Pickles, Salsa, Jelly, Pie Filling, Jam, Meat and Sauces Fresh Longer and Taste Fresher. Making the 16 oz Jar Boss Regular Mouth Mason Jars Ideal for any kitchens, Restaurants and More.
JAR SIZES - This Jar is 5.10 inches High and Can Hold up to 16 Ounces Till Top of the Jar.
PACKAGE TYPE - Standard Packaging
